tasks.label: Pages: build, commit and push
args: Push-Location '${workspaceFolder}/condominio-sol-e-mar/frontend'; npm run build:pages; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Pop-Location; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Pop-Location; git add -A; git diff --cached --quiet; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host 'No changes to commit.'; exit 0 }; git commit -m 'Publish frontend to GitHub Pages'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git push origin master
